difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the flat pullback of the first Chern class of an invertible sheaf against the fundamental class of an integral scheme as the first Chern class of the pulled back sheaf against the fundamental class of the source (statement lines 4236-4247, tag 02SH-adjacent). The proof proves the stronger statement for the divisors of a meromorphic section, reduces locally to the case of a generator where the divisor is that of a rational function, and applies the principal divisor statement. The local reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
